list.title: Agents
list.subtitle: User-created reviewers. Each = provider + model + system prompt + linked skills.
list.emptyBody: An agent is a configured reviewer — a model, a prompt, and the skills it uses. Create one to start reviewing.

create.title: Create agent
create.subtitle: An agent is a configured reviewer — a model, a prompt, and the skills it uses.
create.defaultSystemPrompt: You are a code reviewer. Examine the diff and return at most 5 high-value findings, each citing an exact file:line.

editor.loadErrorBody: The agent could not be loaded.

config.title: Configuration
config.name: Name
config.modelHint: Models are loaded dynamically from the provider's /models.
config.modelEmptyHint: No models loaded — set the {provider} API key in Settings → API Keys.
config.systemPromptHint: Loaded as the static system message. Enabled skills are appended below it.
config.strategyHint: How the diff is sent to the model. Single pass = whole diff in one call (recommended); map-reduce = one call per file (for very large PRs); auto = single pass, switching to map-reduce on large diffs.

strategyOptions.single-pass: Single pass — whole diff in one call
strategyOptions.auto: Auto — single pass, map-reduce when large

config.ciFailOnHint: In GitHub Actions only: when should this agent's review block the PR (request changes + fail the check) vs just comment? Decided by finding severity, not the model. No effect on reviews shown in the studio.
config.repoIntelHint: Inject repo context (repo skeleton, callers of changed symbols, and a 'high blast-radius' note) into this agent's review prompt. On by default. Turning it off sends only the diff — useful for cheap models or self-contained PRs.

skills.title: Skills
skills.orderHint: Order matters — earlier skills appear earlier in the assembled prompt. Drag the handle (or focus it and press ↑ / ↓) to reorder.
skills.orderHintFiltered: Order matters — earlier skills appear earlier in the assembled prompt. Clear the filter to reorder.
skills.globallyDisabledHint: This skill is disabled workspace-wide, so it cannot be added to an agent. Re-enable it in the Skills Lab first.
skills.loadErrorBody: The workspace skills or this agent's links could not be loaded.
skills.saveError: Could not save the skill order.
skills.emptyBody: A skill is a reusable block of review guidance shared across agents. Create one in the Skills Lab, then attach it here.

context.heading: Project context
context.explanation: Order matters — earlier docs appear earlier in the assembled "## Project context" block. Toggle to attach; drag the handle (or focus it and press ↑ / ↓) to reorder.
context.orderHintFiltered: Order matters — earlier docs appear earlier in the assembled "## Project context" block. Clear the filter to reorder.
context.noRepo: Connect a repo to attach project-context documents to this agent.
context.emptyBody: This repo has no Markdown documents yet — add some and rescan from Project Context.

previewPanel.loadErrorBody: The document's content could not be loaded.
previewPanel.missingBody: "{path}" was attached, but the last scan didn't find it on disk — it may have been deleted, renamed or moved.
previewPanel.tooLargeBody: "{path}" is over the attach size limit — open it on GitHub to read it.

mount.body: Mount point for {owner}. The Agent Editor shell + tab routing are wired by A2 — {owner} renders this tab.

evals.noCasesBody: Accept or dismiss a finding on a pull request, then use “Turn into eval case”. The decision is what the case asserts.
evals.providerFailed: This run never reached the model — nothing was measured
evals.deleteConfirm: Delete “{name}”? Its run history goes with it.
evals.editSubtitle: The expectation is what the case asserts — changing it changes what passing means
